infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TopHunt uses the camera so you can take a photo or video for a contest entry, a story, or your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TopHunt needs access to your photos so you can choose an existing photo or video for a contest entry, a story, or your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: TopHunt saves a photo or video to your library when you download it.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: TopHunt uses the microphone to record audio with your contest and story videos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TopHunt uses your location only to show contests and entries near you. You can decline and still use the app.
